question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Gregarious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Sociable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gregarious"** refers to someone who is fond of the company of others; sociable. It is often used to describe individuals who are outgoing, friendly, and enjoy being around people. (सामाजिक)

 
 
• **Example:** She is so gregarious that she makes friends wherever she goes.
 
 
 
• **"Sociable"** is the correct synonym for "gregarious" as it also means being inclined to seek companionship and engage with others. (मिलनसार)
 
 
• **Example:** He is a sociable person who loves attending parties and gatherings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Sociable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Isolated** (अलग-थलग): Describes something or someone that is far away from others or detached.

 
 
• **Example:** After moving to the countryside, she felt isolated from her friends.
 
 
 
• **Introverted** (अंतर्मुखी): Refers to a person who tends to be more focused on their inner thoughts and feelings rather than seeking external stimulation.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an introverted individual who prefers reading books over attending social events.
 
 
 
• **Reserved** (संकोची): Describes someone who is shy or reluctant to share their thoughts or feelings.
 
 
• **Example:** She was reserved at the meeting and spoke only when asked a question.
